typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BAN as string,
		{Service Order} as string,
		{Asset #} as string,
		Datacenter as string,
		CID as string,
		Carrier as string,
		{Carrier Circuit ID} as string,
		Bandwidth as string,
		Type as string,
		{Location A} as string,
		{Location Z} as string,
		{Connector A} as string,
		{Connector Z} as string,
		{Media Type} as string,
		{PO Number} as string,
		{Term in Months} as string,
		MRR as string,
		{Billing Start Date} as date,
		LOA as string,
		{Your Reference Internal Tracking Code} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Fname = $FileName,
		MRR_New = replace(MRR, toString('$'), toString(''))) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		PONumber as string,
		ConnectorA as string,
		ServiceOrder as string,
		MRR as integer,
		BAN as string,
		Type as string,
		LocationZ as string,
		BillingStartDate as string,
		Bandwidth as string,
		YourReferenceInternalTrackingCode as string,
		Datacenter as string,
		Asset as string,
		CarrierCircuitID as string,
		MediaType as string,
		LocationA as string,
		Carrier as string,
		ConnectorZ as string,
		Fname as string,
		TerminMonths as short,
		CID as string,
		LOA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PONumber = {PO Number},
		ConnectorA = {Connector A},
		ServiceOrder = {Service Order},
		MRR = MRR_New,
		BAN,
		Type,
		LocationZ = {Location Z},
		BillingStartDate = {Billing Start Date},
		Bandwidth,
		YourReferenceInternalTrackingCode = {Your Reference Internal Tracking Code},
		Datacenter,
		Asset = {Asset #},
		CarrierCircuitID = {Carrier Circuit ID},
		MediaType = {Media Type},
		LocationA = {Location A},
		Carrier,
		ConnectorZ = {Connector Z},
		Fname,
		TerminMonths = {Term in Months},
		CID,
		LOA),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
